title: NEW L2-only (degraded-mode) — when the task-result fetch persistently fails, the drawer spins 'Pracuji…' forever with no error and no retry affordance, even after the client's own poll shows the task succeeded
expected: After N failed result fetches for a known-terminal task, the drawer shows an error with a retry, not an infinite working state.
got: Reproduced 3/3 on the wedged server (env: /api/tasks/[id] returned HTML 500s while /api/tasks listed status=succeeded): tasks finished server-side in 17–21 s; the drawer showed 'Pracuji…' for 160-172 s+ (whole observation windows), the sidebar badge stayed at the stale count, and no error ever surfaced. Mechanism: useTaskResult retries the full-record fetch forever and silently (TasksProvider.tsx:240-254 — fetchTask swallows non-OK to null), and CandidateDrawer resolves busy only on (succeeded && full) (CandidateDrawer.tsx:346-359). Healthy-server control: the same flow rendered the result in 1.65 s. The 500s themselves were an environment wedge (stale Turbopack cache; fixed by cache-clean restart) — this finding is the UI's response to that failure class, not the 500s.
evidence: run log: taskPolls every ~2s for 170 s with statuses succeeded from t=44s while busy=true persisted (Adam repro)
tasks rows t-mr3rnvt3 (21 s), t-mr3rzss2 (17 s) vs 162/172 s stuck UI
scope_note: ENV NOTE for the run: the wedged dev server (PID 20380, pre-recovery) also 500'd /api/offer/[token], /api/onboarding/*, POST /api/pipeline/[id], /api/status, /api/apply, /api/data, timeline — recovered per the skill's protocol (kill, delete .next, restart :3009); all post-recovery probes returned correct JSON. Product verdicts in this file are from the healthy server.
suggested_acceptance: useTaskResult exposes a fetch-failure state after N retries; the drawer renders it with a retry button.
